Position Summary
We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join a growing corporate finance team at Veridian Global Holdings, a multinational enterprise operating across technology services, industrial software, and managed cloud solutions. This role will sit within the Corporate Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) group and will be responsible for driving financial planning cycles, preparing management and statutory reporting under IFRS, delivering robust financial models, and partnering with business leaders to influence strategic decision-making. The Senior Financial Analyst will play a pivotal role in month-end close, forecasting, and in optimizing processes leveraging SAP FICO. This is a India-based position covering regional and global stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis
- Lead the monthly and quarterly FP&A cadence: prepare and present variance explanations, consolidated forecasts, rolling 12-month cash and P&L projections, and re-forecast scenarios.
- Build and maintain driver-based financial models to support long-range planning, scenario analysis, and strategic business cases.
- Support budgeting and annual operating plan processes, coordinating inputs across business units and consolidating into corporate-level plans.

Reporting & Accounting Compliance
- Prepare and review financial close deliverables ensuring compliance with IFRS reporting requirements and corporate accounting policies.
- Reconcile general ledger sub-accounts in SAP FICO and validate automated journal entries and intercompany eliminations.
- Partner with accounting and external auditors on month-end and year-end reporting requirements and technical accounting queries.

Business Partnering & Decision Support
- Act as primary finance business partner to assigned product lines or functions, providing actionable insights on cost drivers, margin improvement, and capital allocation.
- Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and business case evaluation to support pricing, investment, and go-to-market decisions.
- Translate complex financial results for senior management and non-finance stakeholders through slide decks and executive summaries.

Process Improvement & Systems
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline FP&A processes and reporting automation within SAP FICO and enterprise data warehouses.
- Implement controls and reconciliation frameworks to improve data quality and reduce month-end close cycle time.
- Train and mentor junior analysts on financial modeling best practices and SAP FICO operational workflows.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 6-10 years of progressive finance experience, with significant exposure to FP&A, corporate finance, or financial accounting roles within large enterprises or fast-growing multinationals.

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Financial Modeling
- IFRS
- FP&A
- SAP FICO

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience performing Variance Analysis to explain monthly and quarterly performance drivers across revenue, cost of goods sold, and operating expenses.
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for model building, data manipulation, and scenario analysis.
- Hands-on involvement in the Budgeting process, including top-down and bottoms-up approaches and stakeholder alignment.
- Exposure to reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau) and relational databases is a plus.
- Professional qualification (CA, ACCA, CFA) or equivalent is desirable.

Success Metrics
- Accuracy and timeliness of monthly and quarterly forecasts and variance explanations (target: >95% on-time delivery, variance root-cause coverage for major drivers).
- Quality and adoption of financial models: business users accept model outputs as primary input into strategic decisions.
- Reduction in month-end close cycle time and manual reconciliations through SAP FICO automation initiatives (target: measurable improvement within first 6 months).
- Influence on business outcomes: identified cost-saving or revenue-enhancing opportunities adopted by management and tracked to realization.
- Mentorship impact: junior analyst competency improvement evidenced by reduced error rates and faster turnaround on routine FP&A tasks.
